India Nippon Electricals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: India Nippon Electricals Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 34,748 lakhs for the quarter and 65,196 lakhs for the six-month period. Profit before tax was 2,853 lakhs for the quarter and 6,337 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 9.64 for the quarter and 21.59 for the six months. The company reported total assets of 1,15,842 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. Statutory auditors Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP issued a limited review report on these results. The company noted it has no subsidiaries and does not prepare consolidated financial results.
